svg.title: How the Workflow test runs the reusable workflows
svg.desc: Every pull request and every push to main start the Workflow test. Its first job asks GitHub for the files of a pull request: one that changes nothing that the dry runs run or read skips the calls. Otherwise one job calls each reusable workflow of the commit as a repository does, with the permissions of its template and as a dry run, also from a fork with a token that can only read. Before its checkouts, every job of a reusable workflow stops when GitHub names no commit of the workflow. The labels, the findings and the lifecycle run in full; the issues run with the input smoke, whose job event takes the canary's issue, whose analyze is skipped and whose apply checks the answer of tests/fixtures/smoke-answer.json; the discussions get no event of theirs and skip every job. The last job, the required check reusable workflows, reads the jobs of the run: each one passed with the step that writes the plan of its dry run, or was skipped where its call has to skip it, and it fails on every other.
